intro: This is the region where a radio stops being a hobby. On the G318 west of Kangding you lose mobile coverage for hours at a time, passes reach 5,000 metres, landslides close the road without warning, and the nearest help can be a very long way behind you. Almost every self-drive convoy out here runs 409 MHz walkie-talkies, which is genuinely the most practical thing on this entire site. The upside of the terrain is that from a pass like Zheduo or Dongda, a handheld reaches distances that would be impossible anywhere else in China.
introz: 在这个地区，电台不再是爱好。康定以西的 318 国道上，手机信号会连续几小时中断，山口海拔可达五千米，滑坡毫无预警地封路，最近的救援可能远远落在后面。这里几乎每一支自驾车队都在用 409 MHz 公众对讲机——这可能是整个网站上最实用的一条信息。地形带来的好处是：在折多山或东达山这样的山口，手台能达到中国其他任何地方都不可能的通信距离。

stations.n: 公众对讲机 Ch 19 — the convoy channel
stations.z: 公众对讲机 19 频道 · 车队频道
stations.d: This is what actually matters out here. Self-drive groups on the G318 and G317 run 409 MHz walkie-talkies to warn each other about oncoming trucks on blind corners, road damage, checkpoints and altitude sickness. Channel 1 is unusable because it is the factory default, so organised convoys drift to the top of the band. Set a DCS code and you will hear only your own vehicles.
stations.dz: 这才是这里真正重要的东西。318 和 317 国道上的自驾队伍用 409 MHz 公众对讲机互相提醒盲弯来车、路面损毁、检查站和高原反应。1 频道因为是出厂默认值而无法使用，所以有组织的车队都往频段顶端靠。设一个 DCS 码，你就只会听到自己车队的声音。

stations.n: 公众对讲机 Ch 20 — convoy backup
stations.z: 公众对讲机 20 频道 · 车队备频

stations.n: 公众对讲机 Ch 1 — expect chaos
stations.z: 公众对讲机 1 频道 · 会很乱
stations.d: Worth monitoring anyway, because unorganised groups and truck drivers end up here. Sometimes the road information is useful even when the channel is a mess.
stations.dz: 仍然值得守听，因为没有组织的队伍和货车司机最后都会落到这里。即使频道很乱，路况信息有时也很有用。

stations.z: 进口民用对讲机
stations.d: Some tour operators use imported FRS or GMRS sets, which are in circulation here. Scan 462–468 MHz if you cannot find a group on 409.
stations.dz: 部分旅游公司使用进口的 FRS 或 GMRS 设备，这类设备在国内确实有人在用。如果在 409 上找不到队伍，可扫 462–468 MHz。

stations.n: 2 m FM Calling — from a pass
stations.z: 2 米 FM 呼叫 · 在山口
stations.d: There are almost no repeaters on the plateau, so simplex from height is the realistic option. From Zheduo Shan, Dongda Shan or Mila Shan a 5 W handheld with a clear horizon covers distances that simply do not happen at sea level. This is one of the great VHF locations on earth.
stations.dz: 高原上几乎没有中继台，所以从高处直通才是现实选择。在折多山、东达山或米拉山，地平线开阔时 5 瓦手台的覆盖距离在低海拔地区根本不可能出现。这是全球最好的 VHF 位置之一。

stations.z: 2 米直通 · 队内工作频率
stations.d: If everyone in your group carries a 2 m radio, a simplex channel massively outperforms 409 MHz at 0.5 W. The difference over a mountain pass is not subtle.
stations.dz: 如果队里每个人都带 2 米电台，直通的表现远胜 0.5 瓦的 409 MHz。翻山口时这个差距非常明显。

stations.n: Repeater outputs — worth a scan in Lhasa
stations.z: 中继台下行 · 在拉萨值得扫一下
stations.d: Lhasa and Kangding are the only places out here likely to have working repeaters. Elsewhere, do not count on one.
stations.dz: 拉萨和康定是这一带唯一可能有可用中继台的地方，其他地方不要指望。

stations.z: 高原机场作业
stations.d: Daocheng Yading is among the highest civil airports in the world at over 4,400 metres, and Kangding and Lhasa Gonggar are not far behind. High-altitude operations have unusual performance constraints and the radio traffic reflects it. Scan 118.000–121.400 in AM near any of them.
stations.dz: 稻城亚丁海拔超过 4400 米，是世界上最高的民用机场之一，康定和拉萨贡嘎也相差不远。高原运行有特殊的性能限制，通话内容也体现了这一点。在任何一处附近用 AM 扫 118.000–121.400。

stations.d: From a 4,500 metre pass with nothing between you and the horizon, enroute reception is astonishing. You will hear aircraft that are hundreds of kilometres away.
stations.dz: 在四千五百米的山口上、与地平线之间毫无遮挡时，航路频率的接收效果惊人，能听到几百公里外的航班。

stations.z: 航空紧急频率
各省交通广播 · 扫 87–108 MHz
stations.d: With no continuous weather radio in China and no mobile signal, provincial traffic radio is your only live source for landslide closures and snow on the passes. Coverage comes from small relay transmitters, so sweep the band each time you drop into a new valley rather than keeping one frequency.
stations.dz: 中国没有连续气象广播，这里也没有手机信号，所以各省交通广播是你唯一的实时信息来源，用来了解滑坡封路和山口积雪。覆盖靠小型转播台，所以每进入一个新的河谷都要重扫一遍，不要指望守住一个频率。

stations.z: 四川交通广播转播
藏语广播
stations.d: Tibetan, Yi and other minority-language broadcasting is carried across the plateau on both FM and medium wave. Even without the language it is one of the more memorable things to come across while driving.
stations.dz: 藏语、彝语等少数民族语言广播在高原上通过调频和中波播出。即使听不懂语言，开车途中偶然收到也令人印象深刻。

stations.n: Medium wave at altitude — scan 531–1602 kHz
stations.z: 高海拔中波 · 扫 531–1602 kHz
stations.d: The plateau has essentially no man-made electrical noise, so night-time medium wave and shortwave reception is exceptional. Stations from across Asia arrive cleanly.
stations.dz: 高原上几乎没有人为电气噪声，所以夜间中波和短波接收极为出色，整个亚洲的电台都能干净地收到。

stations.z: 无线列调 · 青藏铁路
stations.d: The world's highest railway, crossing Tanggula Pass at over 5,000 metres. Conventional analog dispatch in the 450 MHz band is worth scanning wherever the road runs near the line.
stations.dz: 世界海拔最高的铁路，在五千米以上跨越唐古拉山口。公路与铁路并行的地段，值得扫一下 450 MHz 的模拟调度。

stations.z: 保护区与林业巡护
stations.d: Nature reserves, fire watch and wildlife patrols operate on VHF nets. Sweep 150–170 MHz inside any reserve.
stations.dz: 自然保护区、防火和野生动物巡护使用 VHF 通信网。进入保护区后扫 150–170 MHz。

stations.z: 救援协调 · 值得了解
stations.d: Mountain rescue here is organised locally and informally rather than on a standard frequency. The practical advice is different from the American version: carry a satellite messenger, because no radio channel out here reliably reaches help.
stations.dz: 这里的山地救援是地方性、非正式组织的，没有统一频率。所以实际建议与美国不同：请带卫星通信设备——这里没有任何一个无线电频率能可靠地联系到救援。

stations.z: BPM 短波授时
stations.d: Extremely clean reception up here. Also 2.5, 5 and 15 MHz.
stations.dz: 在高原上接收非常干净。另有 2.5、5、15 MHz。

stations.z: 国际空间站语音下行
stations.d: High altitude, dry air, no noise floor and a horizon in every direction. Among the best places anywhere to work a satellite pass with a handheld.
stations.dz: 高海拔、干燥空气、没有底噪、四面都是地平线。用手台接收卫星过顶，这里是全球最好的地点之一。

stations.z: SO-50 FM 卫星
